Topline: product org (search + support) evaluating Hosted first; strong preference to move to Dedicated if latency and cost targets met. POC ask: full Dedicated cluster (reserved pool) for 4 weeks, production-like traffic replay, canary + automated fallback to Hosted API during instability.

Requirements summary:
- Workloads: high-throughput embeddings for semantic search (nightly batch + real-time), token-generation for support assistant (low-latency chat).
- Targets: p95 latency < 120ms for chat small-ctx, throughput 1200 reqs/min for embeddings pipeline, cost sensitivity moderate — want 20-30% unit-cost improvement vs Hosted.
- Model preferences: open models (tuned Llama variants) and Redwood-verified quantized variants for Dedicated. Must support model variants for A/B and rollback.
- Routing policy: primary route to Dedicated (us-west), canary at 10% traffic routed to new model_variant_v2, fallback to Hosted API in another region (us-east or eu-west) on degraded health. Want automatic region failover and TTL-based KV cache warming.
- Rollback triggers: error rate > 2% above baseline, p95 latency spike > +300ms, quality regression measured by BLEU/recall drop on holdout prompt set.

Conversation highlights (shorthand):
- "If we can't get predictable p95 under Dedicated, we won't commit." — Head of Product.
- Procurement: "need committed ARR range and break/fallback liability" — CFO.
- Infra: asks for VPC peering diagram + egress IP list.

1) Week 0: baseline metrics collection on Hosted (30% production traffic mirror).
2) Week 1: Deploy Dedicated dev cluster, baseline model (quantized v1), ru n smoke tests.

4) Week 3: Increase traffic to 50% if stable, run failover test to Hosted in us-east and validate cache warming behavior.
5) Week 4: Final quality evaluation, rollback exercises, executive demo, procurement decision.
